input.command:
python -c 'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; from pathlib import Path; out=Path("out"); p="data/crashes.parquet"; names=["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"]; base=duckdb.query(f"SELECT crash_date, dayofweek(crash_date)::INT AS dow FROM read_parquet("{p}") WHERE crash_date >= DATE ''2013-01-01'' AND crash_date < DATE ''2026-01-01''").df(); pooled=base.groupby("dow").size().reindex(range(7),fill_value=0).rename("crash_count").reset_index(); pooled["weekday"]=[names[i] for i in pooled.dow]; pooled["share_pct"]=pooled.crash_count/pooled.crash_count.sum()*100; pooled[["weekday","crash_count","share_pct"]].to_csv(out/"values_1.csv",index=False,float_format="%.6f"); annual=base.assign(year=pd.to_datetime(base.crash_date).dt.year).groupby(["year","dow"]).size().rename("crash_count").reset_index(); totals=annual.groupby("year").crash_count.sum().rename("year_total"); annual["share_pct"]=annual.apply(lambda r:100*r.crash_count/totals.loc[r.year],axis=1); mean=annual.groupby("dow").share_pct.mean().reindex(range(7)).rename("mean_annual_share_pct").reset_index(); mean["weekday"]=[names[i] for i in mean.dow]; mean[["weekday","mean_annual_share_pct"]].to_csv(out/"values_2.csv",index=False,float_format="%.6f"); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5)); bars=ax.bar(pooled.weekday,pooled.share_pct,color="#3b82a0"); ax.set(title="NYC crashes by day of week, 2013–2025",ylabel="Share of crashes (%)",xlabel="Day of week"); ax.bar_label(bars,fmt="%.1f%%",padding=3); ax.set_ylim(0,max(pooled.share_pct)*1.15); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_1.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5)); bars=ax.bar(mean.weekday,mean.mean_annual_share_pct,color="#df8c45"); ax.set(title="Average annual share of NYC crashes by weekday, 2013–2025",ylabel="Mean annual share (%)",xlabel="Day of week"); ax.bar_label(bars,fmt="%.2f%%",padding=3); ax.set_ylim(0,max(mean.mean_annual_share_pct)*1.15); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig); print("Pooled:
"+pooled[["weekday","crash_count","share_pct"]].to_string(index=False)); print("
Equal-weight annual shares:
"+mean[["weekday","mean_annual_share_pct"]].to_string(index=False)); print("
Included rows:",len(base),"; excluded for NULL date within scope:",duckdb.query(f"SELECT count(*) n FROM read_parquet("{p}") WHERE crash_date IS NULL OR (crash_date >= DATE ''2013-01-01'' AND crash_date < DATE ''2026-01-01'' AND crash_date IS NULL)").fetchone()[0]); print("
Annual counts:
"+totals.to_string())'
